defect.summary: A provider 4xx entitlement rejection during revalidation was treated as temporary provider unavailability, preserving the signed session/device reference instead of invalidating them.
defect.impact: Premium remained locked, so no unauthorized content was served, but ACCESS-13 requires disabled/expired/invalid entitlement to clear authorization and be classified as invalid, not outage.
defect.remediation: Typed provider/admin 4xx rejection now maps to session-invalid with both authorization and device cookies cleared. Network, rate-limit, and 5xx errors remain retryable revalidation-unavailable.

evidence_boundary: The Test-mode license key is not recorded.
The screenshot exposed the Test-mode key in the conversation; it should be disabled/deleted after qualification.
